title: #lumen-eng: Auth tokens v2 shipped — Atlas heads up

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Auth tokens v2 is live in prod as of this morning (LMNE-22). Atlas team has been notified via #cross-team. v1 deprecated but staying up until June 15. Monitoring looks clean.

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: Nice ship. Any breaking changes we need to call out in the changelog?

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Yes — token payload now includes `tenantId` and `scopes` fields. Consumers need to check they're not doing strict JSON equality on the token shape.

title: #lumen-eng: Auth service flaky — blocking e2e tests and staging deploys

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: Heads up — the auth service has been throwing intermittent 503s since yesterday afternoon. My Playwright e2e tests (LMNE-25) are failing in CI because of it, and I can't get a clean staging deploy either. Anyone else seeing this?

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: Yes, I noticed it too when testing the design token work. Thought it was just me. How long has it been going on?

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: Since Tuesday around 4pm. It's not constant — maybe 1 in 8 requests fails. Enough to break any test that hits auth.

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: I didn't write a ticket for this yet — assumed it would resolve itself but it clearly hasn't. Let me look at the auth service logs now.

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Found something — the auth service pod is hitting OOM on the k8s node it was rescheduled to after Tuesday's infra maintenance. I'm bumping the memory limit and restarting. Should be fixed in ~10 mins.

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: That fixed it on my end, thanks! Still going to be blocked on LMNE-25 until CI gets a clean run though. Can you write a ticket so this doesn't fall through the cracks?

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Will do after standup.

title: #lumen-eng: Design token migration — Figma sync question

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: PR #34 (design token migration) is up. One question: the Figma tokens export has a `borderRadius/card` value that doesn't exist in our current CSS. Should I add it or skip it for now?

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: Add it — we'll need it for the skeleton loader cards anyway.

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Agreed. Also double-check the `color/interactive/focus` token — I think Figma has a slightly wrong value for dark mode. The contrast ratio was flagged in our a11y audit.

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Quick decision thread: the gesture nav experiment from last sprint got negative feedback in user testing (67% preferred tab bar). I'm going to create LMNE-26 to revert it. Any objections?

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: No objection. Worth noting: Forge's Figma file apparently has a new design spec pushing gesture nav for mobile. Might want to flag that to them — we don't want to build conflicting patterns.

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: Their PR #39 actually has a comment about it too. I'd loop in their design lead before either team finalizes.

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: PR #33 (skeleton loaders) is ready for review. Figma spec is in the Lumen v3 component file. I matched it pixel-for-pixel. @kai-zhang can you take a look?

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: On it. One thing I noticed: the animation uses a 1.5s shimmer cycle — the Figma spec says 1.2s. Minor but let's match it exactly for consistency.

messages.author: priya-nair
messages.text: Sprint 12 week summary: LMNE-17 ✅, LMNE-18 ✅, LMNE-19 ✅, LMNE-20 ✅, LMNE-21 ✅, LMNE-22 ✅. In flight: LMNE-24, LMNE-25, LMNE-26. LMNE-25 was blocked by auth service OOM (Slack thread from Wednesday) — no Jira ticket was filed for that incident despite the ask. Adding to next sprint.

messages.author: dev-okonkwo
messages.text: The auth blocker cost me ~1 day. Would have been faster to diagnose with a Jira ticket and a runbook entry.

messages.author: kai-zhang
messages.text: Agree. Let's make it a team norm: if a blocker persists more than 2 hours, it gets a ticket.
